titles.romaji: Nikuiyo! Galbi-kun: Kemuri ga Me ni Shimiru
titles.native: ニクいよっ！カルビくん～煙が目にしみる～

description: A short gag anime about yakiniku meat on a grill. It primarily focuses on Galbi-kun (beef short rib) who admires a higher cut of meat and tries to change his demeanor to be more refined.
